outcome: Diagnostic ability of prenatal ultrasound for fetal intra-abdominal cysts
Predictive factors for pre- and postnatal outcomes
cohort: This study included 190 fetuses with ultrasound-detected intra-abdominal cysts.
finding: While ultrasound has limited accuracy in diagnosing fetal abdominal cysts, measuring cyst diameter can predict fetal outcomes and identify cases needing intervention or those likely to regress spontaneously.
gest_age: Gestational age was a factor in the predictive model for spontaneous regression.
